source_refs.note: Topic 1.7 Network Protocols and Services as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 14, printed 9); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: A network protocol is a set of rules for communication. It defines how data is formatted and transmitted. Protocols control error handling and data delivery. All devices in a network must follow the same protocol. Protocols ensure smooth data exchange. Examples include TCP/IP and HTTP.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Protocols are like languages that computers use to talk to each other.
